notes.title: Chains on Sand Demo – Combat Overhaul Update (v1.3)
notes.notes:
[p]This latest update brings [b]massive improvements[/b] to the combat system, character builds, and tactical options. After weeks of iteration and community feedback, the demo now reflects what is likely to be the [b]final version of the combat rules[/b] for Chains on Sand.[/p][hr][/hr][h3] Core Combat Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b] New Stun Mechanic[/b]
A successful blow can now [b]stagger your opponent[/b], denying them actions. Use it to break momentum — or suffer it when you drop your guard.[/p][/*][*][p][b] Offhand Attacks Introduced[/b]
Fighters with the right training can now perform [b]offhand attacks[/b], allowing true dual wielding or shield bashes.[/p][/*][*][p][b] New Maneuvers[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Riposte[/b] – A defensive stance that counters incoming attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Illusive Attack[/b] – A feint that lowers defenses.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Defensive Attack[/b] – Attack while staying safe and focused.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] Character Building Overhaul[/h3][list][*][p][b]Universal Skill Costs[/b]
All skills now cost a [b]flat 5 XP per level[/b] — simplifying planning and balancing character builds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Consumables Introduced[/b]
Healing salves, thrown flasks, and other limited-use items are now in the loot pool. (They may appear more frequently in later fights.)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] Bug Fixes & Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Many long-standing bugs were squashed.[/p][/*][*][p]AI behavior is now more responsive and fair.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot transfer and display are now reliable.[/p][/*][*][p]Major systems were refactored to prepare for polish phase.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] Leaderboard Reset[/h3][p]Due to the [b]new combat rules and balance changes[/b], the leaderboard has been [b]reset[/b]. All contenders must now prove themselves under the new rules. Here is the last one for the records - congratulations to the champions![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45620697/453e6050ca98e444cac4356c8c71102360f9ecb7.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3] Legacy Bosses[/h3][p]Some legacy bosses may now appear again in the arena. Enemies that kill your characters may be upgraded to legacy bosses and appear on future runs.[/p][p][/p][h3] Demo Roadmap[/h3][p]This version likely reflects the [b]finalized combat rules[/b] for Chains on Sand. However:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]final demo version[/b] will follow later, focused on [b]visual polish[/b], better animations, and presentation improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bugfixing updates may still appear before that final demo.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3] We Want Your Feedback[/h3][p]Your victories, deaths, and feedback are what shape this game. If you played an earlier version, now is the time to return — the arena is more brutal and rewarding than ever.[/p]

notes.title: Chains on Sand – New Demo Version Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
[p]
We’re excited to announce that a [b]new and improved demo version[/b] of [i]Chains on Sand[/i] will be released next week![/p][h3][b]What’s New & Improved?[/b][/h3][p]Over the last week, we’ve been hard at work based on your feedback and our roadmap. Here’s a sneak peek at what you can expect in the upcoming demo:[/p][list][*][p][b]\[Bugfixes & Combat Improvements][/b]
Cleaner, smoother tactical fights, with better enemy AI, bugfixes, and smarter behavior across all archetypes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Quick Slots, Belts & Swapping][/b]
A fully functional belt & quick slot system: Equip potions, poisons, or tools and use them instantly in combat.
Weapon swapping and item use is now more intuitive![/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Consumables Update][/b]
Poison coating, potion use, and better healing/antidote logic—let your creativity flow![/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI & Experience Tweaks][/b]
Several improvements to stats display, clearer feedback, and overall polish for a more readable and satisfying experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[More Balanced Fights & Smarter Opponents][/b]
Enemies make better use of their gear, potions, and positioning for a real tactical challenge.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Leaderboards Reset][/b]
We will be [b]resetting the Steam demo leaderboard[/b] to ensure a fair competition for everyone!
This is your chance to fight to the top with the new features and claim your spot.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Special Thanks & Coverage[/b][/h3][p]Big thanks to everyone who has played, streamed, and given feedback. [i]Chains on Sand[/i] was recently featured on TurnBasedLovers—check out the article if you haven’t yet![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]The new demo launches next week.[/b]
We hope you’ll jump in, break the game, and let us know what you think.
Get ready to test your mettle (and maybe see your name on top of the leaderboards)![/p][p]Stay sharp and see you in the arena![/p]

notes.title: Chains on Sand — Demo Update & Our “Early Access” Approach!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi contenders![/p][p][b]The new demo version of Chains on Sand is now live![/b]
We want to be clear: This demo is not a fully representative slice of the finished game, but it is our way of opening up the project for real feedback—like an “Early Access,” but free and focused on core combat and systems. We don’t want to charge for feedback, but we [i]do[/i] want your honest thoughts and bug reports![/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]Why This Demo?[/b][/h3][p]Chains on Sand is a tactical arena roguelike where every choice matters—from building your fighter to surviving brutal battles. The full version will have much more content, variety, and polish, but we’re opening up the core now to collect your experiences and impressions. The game is far from done, and what you play here is just the beginning.[/p][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s In the Demo (So Far)?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tactical Arena Combat[/b] with stat-driven mechanics, injury, stamina, and active defense.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Creation[/b] with multiple races, traits, skills, and equipment choices.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Loot, Quality & Durability:[/b] Equipment can be found, looted, equipped, and  has quality and durability that actually matter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Bosses & Legacy Bosses:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The demo features early versions of a "bosses" system, and the start of the [i]legacy boss[/i] system—where common enemies that defeat the players are "promoted" and can come back in later runs.[/p][/*][*][p]These systems will be massively expanded in the full game, with more unique boss personalities and more ways for your own legacy to shape future runs.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Highscore, Progression, and Popularity:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survive, climb the ranks, and see your name in the arena’s records.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s New in This Update?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Major bugfixes to stat/race systems—Orc and Goblin bonuses are now consistent.[/p][/*][*][p]Extra Attack feat is working.[/p][/*][*][p]Interface to show ammount of movement and attacks left before the end of the turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Hit location selection by mouse improved (locks in like keyboard).[/p][/*][*][p]Trait/XP exploit bugs fixed; secondary stats always update.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon and spell visuals polished—sprites now point the right direction.[/p][/*][*][p]Visuals and paperdoll updates for character and equipment in all screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved AI behavior - expect smarter enemies. [/p][/*][*][p]Some minor comestic polishing.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]What’s Still Missing / Needs Feedback?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]The demo is NOT the full game.[/b][/p][list][*][p]No story content, limited bosses, and some unfinished features.[/p][/*][*][p]Legacy and special boss systems are only lightly touched on here—the finished game will have a much deeper, more “persistent world” feeling where your victories (or defeats) echo for future players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Saving/loading is experimental:[/b] Not fully implemented yet. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Bugs or confusion?[/b] Please let us know! Steam forums, Discord, or wherever you prefer.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Help Shape Chains on Sand![/b][/h3][p]We believe the best games are built with the community. If you enjoy deep tactical combat, brutal choices, and leaving your mark on the arena, give the demo a try and tell us what you think. We’re listening![/p][p][b]Chains on Sand will only get better with your input—
Wishlist, play, share, and let us know where you want the arena to go![/b][/p][p]Our Discord: [url="https://discord.gg/w89ERG8X4t"]https://discord.gg/w89ERG8X4t[/url][/p]

notes.title: Chains on Sand Demo – Update 1.13
notes.notes:
[p]This update brings our [b]first Steam Leaderboard integration[/b]—now you can see how your arena performance stacks up against the world (or just your friends)! Compete for the top spot with our new composite “Final Score” system that rewards both fighting skill and efficiency.[/p][p][b]What’s New:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Leaderboards:[/b] Upload your final score at the end of each run and see who’s truly the arena’s champion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Composite Score:[/b] Rankings now reflect fights survived, XP earned, and debt managed. Details are shown on the leaderboard for bragging rights.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Stance changes are now properly tracked and reflected in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Scores are correctly saved on both defeat and demo completion.[/p][/*][*][p]Various small fixes to improve stability and polish.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports!
More features and improvements are on the way—let us know how far you make it up the leaderboard![/p]

notes.title: Demo Release Imminent!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m excited to announce that the first playable demo of Chains on Sand is almost here! After months of development and feedback from testers, I’m preparing to open the doors for you to experience the gritty tactical combat at the heart of the game.

[h3]What Can You Expect?[/h3]
15 rounds of brutal, turn-based arena battles—build your contender, fight for survival, and earn your freedom (or fall to the sands).

[b]Deep tactical combat[/b] with stamina, crippling injuries, weapon reach, armor, magic, and meaningful crowd decisions.

[b]Procedural opponents[/b]: Every enemy is unique, with different archetypes, weapons, and strategies.

[b]Paperdoll equipment system[/b]: Swap weapons, shields, armor, and see them on your character.

[b]Item looting[/b] and durability: Take gear from fallen foes (and watch it break!).

[b]Character progression[/b]: Level up between fights, spend XP, unlock skills and traits.

[b]Reputation and crowd judgment[/b]: The crowd will remember your mercy (or cruelty).

[h3]Please Note:[/h3]
Most of the art is placeholder and many UI elements are still work-in-progress.

Some features, such as the town/rest phase and legendary challenges, are not in the demo yet.

Sound, music, and certain visual effects are being refined—expect rough edges!

But the core combat system is already deep and rewarding. You’ll get a real taste of the tense decision-making and consequences that define Chains on Sand.

[h3]Estimated Playtime[/h3]
The demo offers about 15 arena rounds, enough for several runs and plenty of emergent moments.

I can’t wait to see your feedback and stories from the arena. Thank you for checking out the game—your input will help shape the final release!

[i]Add Chains on Sand to your wishlist to support the project, and let me know what you think after you try the demo![/i]
